The force simulation, vendored so the site makes zero third-party requests.

CORRECTION, and the reason this file now lists four files instead of one.
The d3-force dist bundle does NOT inline its dependencies. Its browser branch
reads them straight off a global that must already exist:

    t((n.d3 = n.d3 || {}), n.d3, n.d3, n.d3)

Shipping d3-force alone therefore loads without error and then throws the
moment the simulation starts, and the only symptom is a graph that never
appears. All four files must be present and loaded in this order.

  1  d3-quadtree.js   5279 bytes   57e2ad12824ed82893ba447523f2a2fb9beeb9222aafb2c778a9f5b313348b0e
  2  d3-dispatch.js   1901 bytes   94b3bbdb6b98dc1325a15762b051013e8253999b0e0436b27d1da17b952ba0af
  3  d3-timer.js      1947 bytes   911ceda305f014b6b53ca68d5c896a9a387da120cfd56a421a2c60cca2fc9b36
  4  d3-force.js      8300 bytes   1e07b473241328795d5ea9ad479a7bbabd765012fa2ef95633c83b69868dff6b

All four are v3, all ISC, and each ships its own LICENSE file beside it because
the ISC licence requires the notice be retained. Origin for every one:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/<name>@3/dist/<name>.min.js
